name: status-2
title: Incident History Feed
description: Incident history feed grouping past incidents by date, each with an impact badge and a timeline of investigating to resolved status updates.

standards.purpose: Answer 'is it working right now, and what happened recently' without a support ticket.
useWhen: Users depend on uptime and need a public health surface.
doNotUseWhen: There is no monitored data to report.

rules.check: Every incident and status update carries an absolute timestamp and timezone.
Status labels match real severity; never show operational during a known outage.
Uptime history states its window and data source.
